text: Shell.jsx's <main> padding: var(--eb-space-6) is the single source of the page gutter on ALL FOUR sides (not just horizontal); PatternsCatalog.jsx, SdlcCatalogPage.jsx, and MainframeCatalogPage.jsx each additionally set their own page-level padding (var(--eb-space-8)/var(--eb-space-6)) on their outer wrapper, doubling the inset — same bug class as KnowledgeFlow.jsx's redundant space-4 padding (#533), fixed together in PR #535.

KB storage branch (env.knowledgeStore.repoRef.branch, resolved by resolveKnowledgeBranch in orchestrator/knowledge-sync.js) is a SEPARATE concept from a repository's code branch; normalizeKnowledgeStore's in-repo fallback must adopt only a repo's url+credentials (adoptRepoForKnowledge), never its code branch, or an unconfigured team silently pushes knowledge to the code branch. Default KB branch is 'agent-knowledge' (not protected).
